Task instance batch number of the instance generated
Task code of the task which refers to this variable
Instance code of the task instance which refers to this variable

Business time of the task instance.Business time is defined as the starting time of the task's frequency cycle.    If now is 3 June 2021, 09:30AM    For daily task the business time is 0AM of the task instance generation date, e.g. 2021-06-03 00:00:00    For weekly task the business time is the Monday 0AM of the task instance generation date, e.g. 2021-05-31 00:00:00    For monthly task, the business time is 0AM of 1st day of the month of the task instance generation date, e.g. 2021-06-01 00:00:00    For hourly task, the business time is the hourly start of the task instance generation time, e.g. 2021-06-03 09:00:00
Date of the current task instance business time, format yyyyMMdd, e.g. 20210603
Previous month of the current task instance business time, format yyyyMM, e.g. 202105
Previous date of the current task instance business time, format yyyyMMdd, e.g. 20210531
Previous hour of the current task instance business time, format yyyyMMddhh, e.g. 2021053109
Year of the current task instance business time, format yyyy, e.g. 2020
Month of the current task instance business time, format yyyyMM, e.g. 202005
Date of the current task instance business time, format dd, e.g. 30
Hour of the current task instance business time , format hh, eg: 18

The time of a day a scheduled task instance is supposed to be launched. If now is 3 June 2021, 09:30AM. For daily, weekly and monthly task, the scheduled time is 0AM of the task instance generation date, e.g. 2021-06-03 00:00:00 For hourly task, the schedule time is the hourly start of the task instance generation time, e.g. 2021-06-03 09:00:00
The date of a scheduled task instance is supposed to be launched, format yyyyMMdd. The date of a scheduled task instance is supposed to be launched, format yyyyMMdd.
The previous date of a scheduled task instance is supposed to be launched, format yyyyMMdd.

The time of a task instance starts running after all input dependencies are met. If the start run time is 3 June 2021, 09:30AM. For daily, weekly and monthly task, the start run time is 0AM of the task instance generation date, e.g. 2021-06-03 00:00:00 For hourly task, the start run time is the hourly start of the task instance generation time, e.g. 2021-06-03 09:00:00
The date of a task instance starts running after all input dependencies are met, format yyyyMMdd.
The previous date of a task instance starts running after all input dependencies are met, format yyyyMMdd.

content:
-- =============================================================================
-- Author:              chengguo.liu@shopee.com
-- Created Time:        2026-01-20
-- Theme Domain:        User Info Freeze Credit Feature
-- Data Granularity:    credit_user_id
-- Description:         用户交易信贷冻结特征表
-- Documents:           
-- =============================================================================
--  Version History:
--  2026-01-20 - chengguo.liu - 初始化
-- =============================================================================


-- drop table if exists ${SCHEMA}.dws_risk_${region}_user_info_credit_freeze_df;
create external table if not exists ${SCHEMA}.dws_risk_${region}_user_info_credit_freeze_df (
    credit_user_id              string  comment 'credit_user_id'
    ,dpd_freeze_date            string  comment 'dpd freeze date'
    ,dpd_freeze_datetime_ts     bigint  comment 'dpd freeze datetime timestamp'
    ,spl_uw_freeze_date         string  comment 'spl uw freeze date'
    ,spl_uw_freeze_datetime_ts  bigint  comment 'spl uw freeze datetime timestamp'
    ,bcl_uw_freeze_date         string  comment 'bcl uw freeze date'
    ,bcl_uw_freeze_datetime_ts  bigint  comment 'bcl uw freeze datetime timestamp'
    ,chp_uw_freeze_date         string  comment 'chp uw freeze date'
    ,chp_uw_freeze_datetime_ts  bigint  comment 'chp uw freeze datetime timestamp'
)
partitioned by
    (grass_date string) stored as orc 
tblproperties ("orc.compress" = "zstd") 
location '${HDFS_PATH}/risk_feature/dws/dws_risk_reg_user_info_credit_freeze_df/grass_region=${grass_region}'
;
-- msck repair table ${SCHEMA}.dws_risk_${region}_user_info_credit_freeze_df;

with 
--dpd_freeze_datetime
user_dpd_freeze as (
    select credit_user_id, max(update_time) as update_time
    from credit_uc.dwd_uc_${region}_user_lock_info_df 
    where lock_type=26 and lock_status=1 and grass_date = '${ds}'
    group by credit_user_id
),

--spl_uw_freeze_datetime
user_spl_uw_freeze as (
    select credit_user_id, update_time 
    from credit_uc.dwd_uc_${region}_user_lock_product_info_df 
    where lock_type=6 and lock_status=1 and biz_type=3 and grass_date = '${ds}'
),

--bcl_uw_freeze_datetime
user_bcl_uw_freeze as (
    select credit_user_id, update_time 
    from credit_uc.dwd_uc_${region}_user_lock_product_info_df 
    where lock_type=6 and lock_status=1 and biz_type=1 and grass_date = '${ds}'
),

--chp_uw_freeze_datetime
user_chp_uw_freeze as (
    select credit_user_id, update_time 
    from credit_uc.dwd_uc_${region}_user_lock_product_info_df 
    where lock_type=6 and lock_status=1 and biz_type=7 and grass_date = '${ds}'
)


INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ${SCHEMA}.dws_risk_${region}_user_info_credit_freeze_df PARTITION (grass_date = '${ds}')
select t1.credit_user_id,
        substring(t2.update_time,1,10) as dpd_freeze_date,
        CAST(to_utc_timestamp(t2.update_time, 'Asia/Bangkok') AS BIGINT) + 3600 * 8 as dpd_freeze_datetime_ts, -- 验证时区是否正确
        substring(t3.update_time,1,10) as spl_uw_freeze_date,
        CAST(to_utc_timestamp(t3.update_time, 'Asia/Bangkok') AS BIGINT) + 3600 * 8  as spl_uw_freeze_datetime_ts,
        substring(t4.update_time,1,10) as bcl_uw_freeze_date,
        CAST(to_utc_timestamp(t4.update_time, 'Asia/Bangkok') AS BIGINT) + 3600 * 8  as bcl_uw_freeze_datetime_ts,
        substring(t5.update_time,1,10) as chp_uw_freeze_date,
        CAST(to_utc_timestamp(t5.update_time, 'Asia/Bangkok') AS BIGINT) + 3600 * 8  as chp_uw_freeze_datetime_ts
from (
    select
        credit_user_id
    from credit_uc.dws_all_prod_${region}_uc_user_df
    where
        grass_date = '${grass_date}'
        and credit_user_id <> ''
        and credit_user_id <> '0'
        and credit_user_id is not null
    group by credit_user_id
) t1
left join user_dpd_freeze t2 on t1.credit_user_id = t2.credit_user_id
left join user_spl_uw_freeze t3 on t1.credit_user_id = t3.credit_user_id
left join user_bcl_uw_freeze t4 on t1.credit_user_id = t4.credit_user_id
left join user_chp_uw_freeze t5 on t1.credit_user_id = t5.credit_user_id
;
